Memorial Details
Type of Memorial
Board / Plaque / Tablet
WMR Reference Number
97249
Description
Rectangular brass plaque screwed onto a stone backplate and mounted on the wall of the Blakley Lane Methodist Chapel. Dedication is incised in black, lower-case script.
Inscription
NEAR THIS SPOT ON 7TH FEBRUARY 1944/ PERISHED THE CREW OF HANDLEY PAGE HALIFAX BB320/ (names)/ ROYAL AIR FORCE VOLUNTEER RESERVE AND/ (name)/ ROYAL CANADIAN AIR FORCE/ "PER ARDUA AD ASTRA" - WWW.INTERNATIONALBCC.CO.UK/ PLAQUE UNVEILED 7TH FEBRUARY 2020
